pages.sites: No sites on this server yet. | One site on this server. | {n} sites on this server.
pages.firewall: Open ports and who can reach them. SSH, HTTP and HTTPS always stay open.
pages.blocklist: Addresses blocked by hand or after repeated failed sign-ins to SSH, WordPress and this panel.
pages.audit: Who changed what on this panel, newest first.
pages.users: People who sign in to this panel, with their role.
pages.settings: Backups, certificates, notifications and updates for the whole server.
pages.security: Your profile, password, two-step verification and sessions ({email}).

backup.retentionHelp: Older snapshots are removed once a day; the newest one that passed its restore test always stays.

destHelp.local: Snapshots are kept in a folder on this server.
destHelp.other: Any service that speaks the S3 API, at the address you give.
destHelp.advanced: The restic repository written out in full: SFTP, REST server, or any other kind restic supports.

backup.localWarning: A folder on this server does not survive the loss of the server. For real off-site backups choose object storage.
backup.advancedHelp: As restic writes it: sftp:user{'@'}host:/path, rest:https://host/, s3:https://endpoint/bucket…
backup.accountHelp: On the R2 page of the Cloudflare dashboard, under Account details.
backup.regionHelp: As the provider writes it, for example {example}.
backup.regionOther: Only if the service asks for one.
backup.bucketHelp: Create it first at the provider; it can stay private.
backup.prefixHelp: To share a bucket with other data, for example cloudground.
backup.keysHelp: A key with read and write access to this bucket only.
backup.passwordSet: Set. Change it only for a new, empty repository: the snapshots already there open only with the old one.
backup.keepPassword: It encrypts every snapshot: without it no backup can be restored, not even by the panel. Copy it or download it now; once saved it is never shown again.
backup.resultHelp: What is saved, as restic reads it.
backup.saveFirst: Save first: the test reads the saved settings.
backup.testHelp: Connects with the saved settings and counts the snapshots.
backup.b2Help: An application key of Backblaze B2 limited to this bucket. Both are stored encrypted.
backup.sshHint: Add this public key to the authorized_keys of the account on the SFTP server. The private key never leaves the panel.
backup.sshNewHint: Backups stop reaching the SFTP server until you add the new public key there.
